market-performance.description: Indian and global benchmark price, return and risk bundle.

indicators.title: Real Effective Exchange Rate

indicators.title: Central government CapEx share
indicators.summary: Compare capital expenditure with total spending while preserving budget vintages.

indicators.title: Headline vs. core CPI inflation

indicators.title: Medium- and high-technology exports
indicators.summary: Track movement toward more sophisticated manufacturing exports.
